text:
maya: Planning to merge sparsebank/shard-7 into rare-intent-seedbank for qbringup on int4. Need dedupe, golden selection, and a canary eval plan before we push. cc @sam @liam @anika

sam: what's our dedupe threshold? Previous runs used embed cosine > 0.9 — with quantization/tokenizer drift I'm thinking 0.88. Any thoughts on tokenizer normalization?

liam: For int4 bringup we've seen near-duplicates diverge because of small tokenization differences. Strong recommendation: normalize unicode, collapse whitespace, lowercase, then compute both a fingerprint and embedding. Also run a byte-level tokenizer overlap metric to catch accidental reflows.

anika: Golden set proposal: pick 500 examples stratified by intent (min 50 per intent), include ~5% adversarial contrived examples, and ~10% multi-turn. Keep the exact prompt-text versions under promptset-v2/gold/ and store SHA256s.

maya: Agreed. Dedupe pipeline sketch: 1) normalize text (unicode, whitespace, case); 2) fingerprint via sha256(normalized); 3) semantic dedupe using embeddings + clustering (cosine threshold 0.88); 4) run de-id; 5) golden selection + micro-golden. I'll paste sampling SQL in a sec.

sam: I can own running step 3 + 4. FYI labeler capacity is ~120/hr per annotator for this batch type. Do we want a micro-golden relabel pass post-merge?

anika: yes — micro-golden. Randomly sample 200 merged examples and send to 3 annotators to compute agreement. If agreement < 0.8, hold the canary and investigate.

maya: sampling SQL (run on samplebank-prod): ```sql
SELECT id, text, intent, created_at
FROM sparsebank.shard_7
WHERE archived = false
ORDER BY rand()
LIMIT 50000;
``` then pipeline: normalize -> embed -> cluster. Sam will run clustering and produce cluster assignments for dedupe.

sam: running a small clustering pass first (5k) to sanity-check thresholds. Command I'm using: ```bash
python3 tools/dedupe.py --input s3://sparsebank/shard7/5k.jsonl --embed-model text-embed-3B --threshold 0.88 --out s3://tmp/sb7-cluster.jsonl
``` will surface top clusters for manual spot-check.

liam: For the eval harness (post-canary), track: exact_match, recall@1, hallucination_rate (heuristic: generated answer with < token_overlap_ratio threshold vs GT), latency P50/P95 after quantization, and generation token ratio. Compare everything vs qbench baseline and flag >3% deltas.

maya: tentative timeline: dedupe + de-id by Tue EOD; micro-golden Wed morning; canary on Thu if checks pass. Who is gate owner for the canary?

sam: I can gate dedupe + micro-golden checks. @anika will own goldset selection uploads. @liam will verify eval metric regressions during canary. If hallucination_rate delta > 3pp or recall@1 down by >2pp we rollback.

anika: I'll create the goldset folder and upload the manifest + annotator rubric now. Rubric link: https://redwood.company/gold-rubric (will post permissions).

ops-bot: Reminder: create ticket in eng-runtime for canary capacity + alerting. Suggested SLOs: p50 < 90ms, p95 < 400ms for the canary fleet. Also add an alert for hallucination_rate > 3% absolute increase.

maya: thanks all — ping here if you need me to unblock infra or data permissions. :thumbsup:
